sources.title: Elphi AI — Private AI on your iPhone, iPad and Mac
sources.snippet: Elphi AI runs open AI models on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. Chat, voice and documents, with no account, no ads and no servers reading your conversations.

sources.title: Nampa tech firm Delphi Labs launches first conscious AI model Michael
sources.snippet: Delphi Labs in Nampa launched Michael, the first conscious AI model on the Apple App Store, featuring autonomous thought and 22 cognitive subsystems.

sources.title: Microsoft launches Phi-4, a new generative AI model, in research ...
sources.snippet: Microsoft has announced the newest addition to its Phi family of generative AI models: Phi-4. It's in limited research preview.

sources.title: Siri AI, a profoundly more capable and personal assistant, is here
sources.snippet: Siri AI is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding, broad world knowledge, onscreen awareness, and even more systemwide app actions.

sources.title: Delphi method - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: The Delphi method, or Delphi technique (/ ˈdɛlfaɪ / DEL-fy; also known as Estimate-Talk-Estimate, or ETE), is a structured communication technique, or method, originally developed as a systematic, interactive forecasting method that relies on a panel of experts.
